import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 限时活动 - 充值档位领取
 * 指令：/活动充值领取 <子活动ID> <档位>
 */
import App from '@src/response-apps/limitedEvent/rechargeClaim/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  const text = (e.MessageText ?? '').trim();
  const match = text.match(/活动充值领取\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)/);

  if (!match) {
    md.addText('格式：/活动充值领取 <子活动ID> <档位>');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '活动充值领取', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const subActivityId = parseInt(match[1], 10);
  const tierLevel = parseInt(match[2], 10);

  const result = await App({ uid, subActivityId, tierLevel, bid, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });

  if (result.code === 'LOAD_FAILED') {
    md.addText(result.data.message);
  } else if (!result.data.success) {
    md.addText(result.data.message || '领取失败');
  } else {
    md.addText(`✅ 充值档${result.data.tierLevel}奖励领取成功！`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`获得：${result.data.rewardText}`));
  }

  md.addNewline();

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '活动充值领取',
      header: [{ label: '返回充值', command: '/活动充值' }],
      content: md
    })
  );
});
